articles.title: Neologism Inoculation Prompting
articles.abstract: Inoculation prompting is a method to reduce undesired behaviours such as reward hacking in frontier models. It works by training a model on harmful examples under a prompt that specifies the undesired behaviour, which reduces the model's tendency to exhibit it unless prompted. However, the inoculation prompt is written in plain English, so any user can re-elicit the behaviour easily. We introduce neologism inoculation prompting (NIP), which replaces the English prompt with a new token that is trained on the frozen model and removed at deployment. NIP outperforms other inoculation methods, and performs competitively with gradient routing despite being simpler. It also works on reward hacking, but fails on sycophancy and harassment. Using control tokens and analyses of activations, we identify the mechanism for this as NIP hiding the harmful behaviour behind an unreachable region of model inputs, rather than deleting it. More broadly, our work suggests that neologisms can be a powerful way to carve out and shape access to behaviours that are undesired or harmful.
articles.abstractCn: 接种提示是一种减少前沿模型中不期望行为（如奖励操纵）的方法。它通过在指定不期望行为的提示下训练模型，从而降低模型表现出该行为的倾向，除非再次提示。然而，接种提示是用普通英语书写的，因此任何用户都可以轻易重新引发该行为。我们引入了新词接种提示（NIP），它用一个新的标记替换英语提示，该标记在冻结的模型上进行训练，并在部署时移除。NIP优于其他接种方法，尽管更简单，但其性能与梯度路由具有竞争力。它也能应对奖励操纵，但在奉承和骚扰方面失败了。通过使用控制标记和激活分析，我们确定了其机制：NIP将有害行为隐藏在模型输入的一个不可达区域中，而不是删除它。更广泛地说，我们的工作表明，新词可以是一种强大的方法，用于划分和塑造那些不期望或有害的行为的访问权限。

articles.title: COMPREHEND: Ultra-Fine-Grained Benchmark Understanding by Entailment Hierarchy
articles.abstract: Understanding what kind of prompts users typically ask and how well an LLM performs on these prompt categories is crucial for LLM practitioners. The existing methods satisfy the demand by hierarchically clustering the user prompts and synthesizing the cluster names using an LLM to build a taxonomy. However, the cluster names from these methods are usually too general for humans to understand the detailed prompt distributions and identify the exact strengths and weaknesses of LLMs. In this study, we propose COMPREHEND, which automatically constructs an ultra-fine-grained entailment hierarchy for the prompts. The entailment hierarchy replaces the cluster names in the taxonomy with sentences to provide more precise cluster descriptions for more fine-grained categorization. Compared with EvalTree, a state-of-the-art taxonomy construction method, COMPREHEND improves an entailment/faithfulness metric from 22.6 to 41.7 and an informative metric from 16.3 to 39.1 in WildBench. Our experiments also show that the weakness report generated based on our entailment hierarchy is much more informative than EvalTree in terms of predicting the response scores in the benchmark. All the code is released in https://github.com/JackNapier20/COMPREHEND_public.
articles.titleCn: 理解：基于蕴涵层次的超细粒度基准
articles.abstractCn: 理解用户通常询问的提示类型以及大型语言模型在这些提示类别上的表现，对于大型语言模型从业者至关重要。现有方法通过分层聚类用户提示，并使用大型语言模型合成聚类名称来构建分类体系，从而满足这一需求。然而，这些方法生成的聚类名称通常过于笼统，人类难以理解详细的提示分布，也无法准确识别大型语言模型的优缺点。在本研究中，我们提出了COMPREHEND，该系统自动构建了提示的超细粒度蕴涵层次结构。蕴涵层次结构用句子替换分类体系中的聚类名称，为更细粒度的分类提供更精确的聚类描述。与EvalTree这一最先进的分类体系构建方法相比，COMPREHEND在WildBench上将蕴涵/忠实度指标从22.6提升至41.7，信息量指标从16.3提升至39.1。我们的实验还表明，基于我们的蕴涵层次结构生成的弱点报告，在预测基准测试中的响应分数方面，比EvalTree更具信息量。所有代码已发布在https://github.com/JackNapier20/COMPREHEND_public。

articles.title: Constructing a Regional Slang Lexicon for Electricity Demands via Soft-Label Bidirectional Anchoring and Active Learning
articles.abstract: Power-grid customer service increasingly relies on community social media, where customers describe outages, billing, and equipment faults in informal regional dialect. Such messages exhibit non-standard morphology, semantic drift, and out-of-vocabulary expressions that make manual lexicon construction costly and degrade conventional NLP tools. We propose a weak-supervision framework constructing a regional slang lexicon from curated dialect anchors and power-domain seed terms. Candidates are generated via Pointwise Mutual Information with soft-label bidirectional anchoring, retaining dialect-anchored terms while recording power-domain relevance as separate metadata, and are scored by combining Sentence-BERT semantic similarity with a jieba-based wordhood measure. Uncertainty-aware active learning with rule-based and retrieval-augmented LLM oracles is applied under three query strategies, and the resulting lexicon is evaluated by a higher-capability LLM calibrated against human expert annotations via Cohen's $κ$. On 11,177 real WeChat messages from Yuxi (Yunnan, China), the framework achieves an evaluator-estimated dialect precision of DP~$=$~1.0 with zero false positives. An ablation shows that soft-label layering retains 751\% more candidates than strict power-gating at identical precision, expanding the candidate pool from 41 to 349 terms. Human calibration ($n=46$) yields $κ_{\text{dialect}}=1.0$ and $κ_{\text{power}}=0.85$. The resulting 25--33-term lexicon, 4--5 of which are power-relevant, provides a preliminary resource for dialect-aware power-grid service NLP.
articles.titleCn: 基于软标签双向锚点和主动学习的区域电力需求方言词汇构建
articles.abstractCn: 电网客户服务日益依赖社区社交媒体，用户在其中用非正式的区域方言描述停电、账单和设备故障。这些信息表现出非标准形态、语义漂移和词汇外表达，导致人工构建词汇表成本高昂，并损害传统自然语言处理工具。我们提出了一种弱监督框架，从精选方言锚点和电力领域种子词构建区域俚语词汇表。候选词通过点互信息结合软标签双向锚点生成，保留方言锚点词的同时将电力领域相关性记录为独立元数据，并通过结合Sentence-BERT语义相似度和基于jieba的词性度量进行评分。在三种查询策略下应用不确定性感知主动学习，并使用基于规则的检索增强大型语言模型预言机，最终词汇表通过Cohen's $κ$校准的人专家注评估。在云南玉溪的11,177条真实微信消息中，该框架实现评估者估计的方言精确度DP~$=$~1.0，且无假阳性。消融实验表明，软标签分层比严格电力门控在相同精确度下保留了751%更多的候选词，将候选词池从41个词扩展到349个词。人类校准（$n=46$）得到方言校准系数$κ_{\text{dialect}}=1.0$和电力校准系数$κ_{\text{power}}=0.85$。最终生成的25--33词词汇表，其中4--5个词与电力相关，为方言感知电网服务NLP提供初步资源。

articles.title: Shared Context Candidate Scoring with Jointly Adapted Readout Networks
articles.abstract: Repeated decisions over a shared document create two distinct opportunities: reusing document computation and adapting how question representations score candidate answers. We present Q64, a candidate-scoring system that preserves a frozen 64-layer Qwen3.8-27B text backbone, reuses its hybrid prefix state and intermediate document representations, and jointly trains a residual adapter with a four-layer decoder and candidate-conditioned readout. We used ZiYor, a self-evolving AI system, to explore and refine the Q64 design. We specified the scoring method, implemented the system, and evaluated its accuracy and latency. The final adaptation stage updates 88.66 million parameters using 8,192 selected training views. On a fixed 5,112-item evaluation combining ARC-Challenge, ANLI-R3, and stratified subsets of MMLU-Pro and CMMLU, joint adaptation improves four-benchmark macro accuracy from 66.46% to 74.32%. It remains below the native 27B baseline at 75.68% and AnyJev Qwen3-32B L0 at 76.68%. On a separate synthetic workload with 4,096 document tokens and 50 questions, median cold-request latency is 2.237 seconds, compared with 5.383 seconds for the native baseline and 56.872 seconds for the measured batched AnyJev configuration. Short single-question requests do not share this advantage. The evidence supports an accuracy-latency tradeoff in the evaluated systems, rather than a backbone reduction or an isolated component advantage. Public benchmarks informed earlier development, and real-document multi-question validation remains open.
articles.comment: 11 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Jingyang Du and Yiben Fu contributed equally to this work and share first authorship. Corresponding author: Yang Shen
articles.titleCn: 共享上下文候选评分与联合适配读出网络
articles.abstractCn: 针对共享文档的重复决策创造了两个独特的机遇：复用文档计算结果以及调整问题表示对候选答案的评分方式。我们提出了Q64，一个候选评分系统，该系统保留了一个冻结的64层Qwen3.8-27B文本主干，复用了其混合前缀状态和中间文档表示，并联合训练了一个包含四层解码器和候选条件化读出的残差适配器。我们使用自进化AI系统ZiYor探索并优化了Q64的设计。我们明确了评分方法，实现了该系统，并评估了其准确性和延迟。最终适配阶段使用8,192个选定的训练视图更新了8866万个参数。在一个包含ARC-Challenge、ANLI-R3以及MMLU-Pro和CMMLU分层子集的固定5,112项评估中，联合适配将四个基准的宏观准确率从66.46%提升至74.32%。其表现仍低于原生27B基线的75.68%和AnyJev Qwen3-32B L0的76.68%。在一个包含4,096个文档词元和50个问题的独立合成工作负载中，中位数冷请求延迟为2.237秒，而原生基线的延迟为5.383秒，测量的批量AnyJev配置的延迟为56.872秒。短单问题请求并不具备这种优势。证据表明，在评估系统中存在准确性与延迟的权衡，而非主干缩减或孤立组件的优势。公开基准指导了早期的开发工作，而真实文档多问题验证仍待进行。

articles.title: Tokenizer Myths and Where To Find Them
articles.abstract: Tokenization is a fundamental component of modern language models: before a model sees data, its tokenizer has already determined how the data appears. We identify and challenge three myths in the tokenization research literature. Myth #1: Bits-Per-Byte (BPB) is agnostic to the tokenizer and/or the vocabulary size: BPB is tokens per byte times bits per token, and the two factors do not cancel; using untrained models, we show that BPB prefers some tokenizers over others: the model has learned nothing, but the tokenizer--model pair has. Myth #2: lower BPB means a better model: On untrained models, BPB strongly prefers some vocabulary sizes, even though accuracy remains at chance, and on real models trained on the same data, BPB correlates weakly with downstream performance. Myth #3: different "tokenizer-agnostic" metrics yield consistent results: The "unigram-normalized loss" is not tokenizer-agnostic; its reported correlation of 0.989 with BPB comes from a confounder and falls to 0.057 once fixed; from the same data the two metrics select different vocabularies at each model size. We present a tokenizer trilemma: no metric can score only the true distribution best, give the same predictions the same score, and tie all untrained models, so choosing a metric is choosing a research question. We conclude with a caution for reading the tokenization literature and a conjecture for future work.
articles.titleCn: 分词器的迷思及其出处
articles.abstractCn: 分词是现代语言模型的基本组成部分：在模型看到数据之前，其分词器已经确定了数据的表现形式。我们在分词研究文献中识别并挑战了三种神话。神话 #1：比特每字节（BPB）与分词器及/或词汇量无关：BPB是每字节数量乘以每个词的比特数，这两个因素不会相互抵消；使用未训练模型，我们证明BPB更倾向于某些分词器而非其他分词器：模型本身什么都没学到，但分词器-模型对却学到了。神话 #2：较低的BPB意味着更好的模型：在未训练模型上，BPB强烈倾向于某些词汇量大小，尽管准确率仍保持在随机水平，而在使用相同数据训练的真实模型上，BPB与下游性能的相关性很弱。神话 #3：不同的“与分词器无关”指标得出一致的结果：“一元组标准化损失”并非与分词器无关；其报告的与BPB的0.989相关性来自混杂因素，一旦修正后降至0.057；从相同数据中，这两个指标在每个模型大小下选择了不同的词汇表。我们提出了一个分词三难困境：没有指标能最好地评分真实分布，给相同预测相同的分数，并使所有未训练模型并列，因此选择指标就是选择研究问题。最后，我们对阅读分词文献提出警示，并对未来工作提出猜想。

articles.title: Length Is Cheap, Competition Is Not: Attention Predicts Context Rot in Retrieval
articles.abstract: Why do language models fail on long inputs? The common answer is length. We show that, for retrieval, length is cheap and competition is not. On five open models (0.5B to 3B parameters, four families), neutral filler costs nothing: accuracy stays at 0.97 to 1.00, up to 32K tokens on Qwen2.5-1.5B. Statements in the format of the evidence, placed at the same positions, drop it to 0.16 to 0.33. A single statement that gives the queried key a rival value multiplies the loss by 9 to 110, and every additional rival adds to it. Inside the model, one quantity tracks the failure: the attention mass left on the evidence. Across 126,473 trials it explains up to 58% of the variance in loss; log length explains at most 8%. The masked-filler protocol behind the claim that length alone hurts reproduces on MMLU (11 to 18 points lost at 30K tokens), but fails a visible control in retrieval: masking costs 45 accuracy points at 32K tokens, while the same filler left visible costs none. In retrieval, context rot is a competition for attention. We release the probe and all 126K trial-level measurements.
articles.comment: 15 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Code and trial-level data: https://github.com/yliusci/length-is-cheap
articles.titleCn: 长度廉价，竞争不贵：注意力预测检索中的上下文退化
articles.abstractCn: 为什么语言模型在处理长输入时会失败？常见的答案是长度问题。我们证明，对于检索任务，长度是廉价的，而竞争才是昂贵的。在五个开放模型（0.5B到3B参数，四个家族）上，中性填充词不耗费成本：准确率保持在0.97到1.00，在Qwen2.5-1.5B模型上可达到32K个token。以证据格式放置的陈述，放在相同位置时，准确率会降至0.16到0.33。一个给查询键赋予竞争值的单一陈述会使损失增加9到110倍，并且每个额外的竞争值都会加剧这一损失。在模型内部，有一个量值追踪这种失败：证据上的注意力质量。在12万6473次试验中，它解释了损失中高达58%的方差；而日志长度最多只能解释8%。声称仅长度会损害性能的断言背后的掩码填充协议在MMLU上重现了（在30K个token时损失11到18分），但在检索任务中却失败了一个可见控制：掩码填充在32K个token时损失了45分，而相同的填充词若保持可见则不造成任何损失。在检索任务中，上下文退化是一种对注意力的竞争。我们发布了探测工具和所有12.6万次试验级别的测量数据。

articles.title: PACT: Certifying What Is Written in Parallel Decoding of Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Parallel decoding speeds up masked diffusion language models by writing several tokens per forward pass. Published commit rules choose these tokens by testing the predicted distributions. Under sampling the written tokens are drawn, and these tests do not see them. We find that answer quality follows the reliability of the tokens actually written. An answer's log probability splits into this reliability and the dependence within each step. We propose PACT, a training-free commit rule that draws the tokens first, certifies the set it will write and spaces the positions of each step apart. This certificate holds at every temperature, and we show that no rule with the same guarantee commits more positions. Experiments use four models of the LLaDA and Dream families and HumanEval, MBPP, GSM8K, MATH500 and IFEval benchmarks. PACT reaches the quality of published commit rules with fewer forward passes. Spacing removes positions from each step, yet it usually lowers the total cost because later steps then write more tokens. At the same speed, published decoders also write a word twice in a row far more often than PACT. These results suggest that commit rules should certify the tokens they write. Code is available at https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/PACT.
articles.titleCn: PACT：在扩散语言模型的并行解码中对所写内容进行认证
articles.abstractCn: 并行解码通过每轮前向传播写入多个标记来加速掩码扩散语言模型。已发布的提交规则通过测试预测分布来选择这些标记。在采样写入的标记时，这些测试无法看到它们。我们发现答案质量遵循实际写入标记的可靠性。答案的对数概率分为这种可靠性和每一步内的依赖关系。我们提出了PACT，一种无需训练的提交规则，它首先抽取标记，认证将要写入的集合，并将每一步的位置错开。这个认证在每种温度下都有效，我们证明没有任何具有相同保证的规则会提交更多位置。实验使用了LLaDA和Dream系列的四个模型以及HumanEval、MBPP、GSM8K、MATH500和IFEval基准。PACT用更少的前向传播达到了已发布提交规则的质量。错开位置从每一步中移除位置，但通常降低总成本，因为后续步骤随后写入更多标记。在相同速度下，已发布的解码器也远比PACT更频繁地在连续两次写入同一个词。这些结果表明，提交规则应该认证它们写入的标记。代码可在https://github.com/LiZaiyuan0619/PACT获取。

articles.title: AdSteer: Native Advertising in Large Language Model Generation
articles.abstract: Large language model (LLM) services face rapidly rising serving costs. To sustain free or affordable access for a broad user base, alternative monetization mechanisms are needed. Native advertising offers a promising approach, as it creates economic value by aligning user intent with merchant offerings. Yet how to integrate sponsored content naturally into LLM responses remains largely underexplored. Existing approaches primarily rely on prompt-level injection, multi-pass rewriting, or fine-tuning, which can compromise response quality or introduce additional computational costs. We propose AdSteer, a lightweight decoding-time advertising framework that adaptively adjusts token probabilities to integrate contextually appropriate advertisement into responses. AdSteer calibrates the strength and duration of advertising influence, making sponsored content a natural part of the response. Experiments on GEM-Bench across three application scenarios show that AdSteer achieves an average improvement of 14.1% in overall score over the strongest baselines and 22.5% fewer total tokens on average than rewrite-based methods. These results demonstrate that AdSteer provides an effective and practical solution for native advertising in LLMs.
articles.titleCn: AdSteer：大型语言模型生成中的原生广告
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）服务面临着服务成本快速上升的挑战。为了维持对广大用户群体的免费或可负担的访问，需要探索替代性的盈利机制。原生广告提供了一种有前景的方法，因为它通过将用户意图与商家提供的内容相结合来创造经济价值。然而，如何将赞助内容自然地融入LLM响应中仍然是一个尚未充分探索的问题。现有的方法主要依赖于提示级注入、多轮重写或微调，这些方法可能会影响响应质量或引入额外的计算成本。我们提出了AdSteer，这是一个轻量级的解码时广告框架，它通过自适应调整标记概率来将上下文相关的广告内容融入响应中。AdSteer校准了广告影响的强度和持续时间，使赞助内容成为响应的自然组成部分。在GEM-Bench上的三个应用场景实验表明，AdSteer在总体得分上比最强的基线平均提高了14.1%，并且比基于重写的方法平均减少了22.5%的总标记数。这些结果表明，AdSteer为LLM中的原生广告提供了一种有效且实用的解决方案。

articles.title: Where Do Distilled Students Store Thinking?
articles.abstract: Small students degrade on large reasoning models' (LRMs') long solutions, so recent work shortens them by interpolating an LRM with a short-answer model at ratio $λ$. We ask what student weights retain when this teacher stops thinking, comparing LoRA adapters of three students from three teacher pairs at each $λ$. In each pair, the adapters' update subspace shifts most where the teacher stops thinking and solutions shorten most, locating the change without attributing it. We identify a shared adapter subspace tied to thinking-like behavior (reflective markers, monologue format and long solutions). Shared by adapters before that point, it keeps about half (post hoc) while one pair's teacher halves its solutions but keeps its think tag, and largely empties after thinking stops. Removing it largely turns this behavior off for every pair, student and benchmark. Only in that pair and one other student does it leave clearly fewer markers than removing the update's top components; elsewhere, same-energy random directions often nearly match it. Grafted into a short-answer student at twice its weight, it turns early markers (a post hoc count) on, like the whole update, but the student rarely finishes. Our work identifies a weight subspace tied to distilled thinking-like behavior.
articles.titleCn: 蒸馏学生把思考储存在哪里？
articles.abstractCn: 小模型在大推理模型（LRM）的长答案中表现不佳，因此近期研究通过以比例 $λ$ 将LRM与短答案模型进行插值来缩短答案。我们探究当教师停止思考时，学生保留了哪些权重，通过比较每个 $λ$ 下三对教师对应的三名学生LoRA适配器。在每对中，适配器的更新子空间在教师停止思考且答案缩短最多的地方发生最大变化，从而定位变化而不进行归因。我们识别出一个与思考行为相关的共同适配器子空间（反映性标记、独白格式和长答案）。在此之前的适配器共享该子空间，当其中一对教师的答案减半但保留思考标签时，该子空间保留约一半（事后分析），而在思考停止后则大量消失。移除该子空间会大幅削弱这对教师、学生和基准的行为。只有在这对教师和一名其他学生中，它留下的标记明显少于移除更新最高组件的标记；在其他地方，同等能量的随机方向往往几乎与之匹配。将其嫁接到权重为其两倍短答案学生上，会像整个更新一样激活早期标记（事后计数），但学生很少能完成。我们的工作识别出一个与蒸馏思考行为相关的权重子空间。

articles.title: LoopKV: Loop-Aware KV Cache Compression for Serving Looped Transformers
articles.abstract: Looped transformers apply a shared block several times per token to improve accuracy without adding parameters. For models such as Ouro that keep a separate key-value (KV) cache per loop, cache memory limits the batch size that amortizes repeated weight reads. Uniform-bit quantization and fixed rules per loop do not allocate precision according to each layer's sensitivity in each loop. Measurements on Ouro show that quantization sensitivity varies across (loop, layer) cells, and the sum of individual cell damages approximates the overall output damage. Sharing damage also varies by cell, with later loops generally tolerating sharing better. Skipping low-attention values to save reads produces errors that compound across loops. LoopKV uses a one-time offline profile to choose 4-bit storage, 2-bit storage or reuse of the final loop's KV for each cell. The planner minimizes reads under budgets for predicted damage and storage. During decoding, each loop reads the high 2 bits of each 4-bit value and fetches the low bits only where its own attention weights require 4-bit precision. A single fused kernel in vLLM executes the plan. Serving Ouro-1.4B on one RTX PRO 6000, the memory-optimized LoopKV-M plan stores 35% less KV than uniform 4-bit quantization (KIVI-4) on the same fused kernel and CUDA graph. It sustains 1.7-2.2x KIVI-4's goodput under a latency service-level objective with a 16K-token maximum length. None of its averages on six public benchmarks falls significantly below BF16's.
articles.titleCn: LoopKV：面向循环Transformer服务的循环感知KV缓存压缩
articles.abstractCn: 循环Transformer通过每个token多次应用共享模块来提高准确率，而无需增加参数。对于Ouro等保留每个循环独立键值（KV）缓存的模型，缓存内存限制了摊销重复权重读取的批处理大小。均匀位量化以及每个循环的固定规则不会根据每个循环中每层的敏感性分配精度。对Ouro的测量表明，量化敏感性在（循环，层）单元间存在差异，各单元损坏的总和近似等于整体输出损坏。共享损坏也因单元而异，较晚的循环通常更能容忍共享。跳过低注意力值以节省读取会导致错误在循环间累积。LoopKV使用一次性离线分析来为每个单元选择4位存储、2位存储或重用最终循环的KV。规划器在预测损坏和存储预算下最小化读取。在解码期间，每个循环读取每个4位值的最高2位，仅在自身注意力权重需要4位精度时才获取低位。vLLM中的单个融合内核执行该计划。在单个RTX PRO 6000上服务Ouro-1.4B，内存优化的LoopKV-M计划在相同的融合内核和CUDA图上比均匀4位量化（KIVI-4）存储35%更少的KV。在具有16K-token最大长度的延迟服务等级目标下，它维持了1.7-2.2倍的KIVI-4的吞吐量。它在六个公共基准测试中的平均性能均未显著低于BF16。

articles.title: Say Less, Mean Better: Training-Free Verbosity Control for Language Models
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often generate responses longer than necessary, increasing inference latency and computational cost. While prompting can encourage conciseness, controlling output length without compromising response completeness remains challenging. Aggressive early stopping can reduce generation costs but risks terminating responses prematurely. We introduce MinimalLM, a training-free framework for reliable verbosity control that combines uncertainty-aware, length-dependent stop-token adjustment with structural completeness guardrails. MinimalLM separates the decision of when to stop from whether stopping is structurally appropriate, coordinating response-level instructions, decoding-time intervention, and completion checks without modifying model parameters or requiring auxiliary models. We evaluate MinimalLM across three open-source LLMs and 330 questions, producing 5,940 responses across baseline and ablation configurations. MinimalLM reduces generated tokens by 47.6%, accelerates individual responses by 19-68%, and eliminates structurally truncated outputs in the primary evaluation. Despite substantial token savings, it achieves an average quality score of 8.04/10, compared with 8.42/10 for unmodified models and 6.46/10 for length-matched truncation. Evaluations across diverse subject domains (such as healthcare, programming, law, and science) demonstrate robust efficiency gains, while ablations establish the complementary roles of decoding control and completeness constraints. Our findings highlight that efficient generation requires more than producing fewer tokens: it requires controlling when generation ends while preserving response integrity. MinimalLM offers a lightweight, training-free approach toward this goal.
articles.titleCn: 少说多精：无需训练的语言模型冗余控制
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）生成的响应往往超出必要长度，增加了推理延迟和计算成本。尽管提示可以鼓励简洁性，但在不牺牲响应完整性的情况下控制输出长度仍然具有挑战性。激进式早期停止可以降低生成成本，但存在提前终止响应的风险。我们引入了MinimalLM，这是一个无需训练的可靠冗余控制框架，它结合了不确定性感知、长度相关的停止标记调整以及结构完整性约束。MinimalLM将决定何时停止与停止是否结构上合适分开，协调响应级指令、解码时干预和完成检查，而无需修改模型参数或需要辅助模型。我们在三个开源LLMs和330个问题上评估了MinimalLM，在基线和消融配置下生成了5,940个响应。MinimalLM将生成的标记减少了47.6%，将单个响应加速了19-68%，并在主要评估中消除了结构上截断的输出。尽管标记节省了大量，但它实现了平均质量分数8.04/10，而未修改模型的分数为8.42/10，长度匹配截断的分数为6.46/10。跨不同主题领域（如医疗保健、编程、法律和科学）的评估展示了稳健的效率提升，而消融实验确立了解码控制和完整性约束的互补作用。我们的研究强调，高效的生成不仅需要生成更少的标记，还需要控制生成何时结束，同时保持响应的完整性。MinimalLM提供了一种轻量级、无需训练的方法来实现这一目标。

articles.title: Evaluation Contracts and Evaluation Leverage: Sliced-Gap Readings in Structured Prediction Can Move Without Model Change
articles.abstract: NLP evaluation reports routinely cite sliced performance differences, most prominently the intra-inter gap in document-level relation extraction, as capability evidence. We show that such gap readings are joint properties of models and evaluation contracts: scoring function, gold version, threshold, output format, and prompt language. With predictions frozen, a method ordering reverses under a gold-standard exchange (+0.0363, CI excluding zero; tie-level after), movement localizing where gold re-partitions: renames are gauge transformations (Delta=0; re-annotation +0.862). We formalize this as an evaluation leverage account centered on the rank-flip condition. Constructively, the audited evaluation reading (AER) is a contract-marginalized, tie-declared, seed-prescribed, gate-filtered procedure whose tie declarations cover every contract-induced flip on the declared WMT19 grids (14/14; held-out 73% vs. union-of-ties 89%), matching the best single metric contract at epsilon=0.10 equivalence. Evidence spans DocRE, HacRED, a UD probe, and released gold revisions; an alternative-reference-set replication extends it beyond our testbeds. Failed predictions retained as boundaries; a 5% violation gate flags unverifiable settings and bounds survivor-selection bias. We release EvalLever, a preregistered workflow with an amendment trail; on LLM-as-judge grids, the audited ensemble stabilizes every unstable pair (13-15 to zero; generic ensemble shrinkage: the preregistered correlation criterion failed, the companion stabilization criterion passed).
articles.titleCn: 评估合同与评估杠杆：结构化预测中的切片间隙阅读可以在不改变模型的情况下移动
articles.abstractCn: NLP评估报告通常引用切片性能差异，尤其是文档级关系抽取中的内-外差距，作为能力证据。我们表明，此类差距读数是模型和评估契约的联合属性：评分函数、黄金版本、阈值、输出格式和提示语言。在预测固定的情况下，方法排序在黄金标准交换下逆转（+0.0363，置信区间排除零；在平局水平之后），运动定位在黄金重新划分处：重命名是度量变换（Delta=0；重新标注+0.862）。我们将其形式化为以排名翻转条件为中心的评估杠杆账户。在建设性方面，经过审计的评估读数（AER）是一个契约边缘化、平局声明、种子指定、门限过滤的程序，其平局声明涵盖了每个契约引起的在声明WMT19网格上的翻转（14/14；排除73%与平局集联合89%），匹配了在epsilon=0.10等价下的最佳单一指标契约。证据涵盖DocRE、HacRED、一个UD探针和发布的黄金修订版；一个替代参考集的复制将其扩展到我们的测试平台之外。失败的预测保留为边界；一个5%的违规门限标记不可验证的设置和边界幸存者选择偏差。我们发布了EvalLever，一个预先注册的工作流程，带有修订记录；在LLM作为裁判的网格上，经过审计的集成稳定了每个不稳定的对（13-15变为零；通用集成缩小：预先注册的相关性标准失败，伴随的稳定化标准通过）。

articles.title: When Strong Reasoners Join the Pool: Small Union Premiums and Costly Runaway Generations in LLM Routing
articles.abstract: Routing benchmarks often judge a router against a hindsight oracle that counts a query as solved whenever any model's recorded answer is correct, but under stochastic decoding that oracle mixes two different objects: the clairvoyant ceiling of committing to one model per query and the premium of calling several models and keeping any correct answer. A companion study measured this premium at 3.5 percentage points (pp) for 11 small open models on MATH-500; how large it is once current reasoning models enter the pool was unknown. We measure it with a fixed-protocol, pre-committed generation on a single NVIDIA B300: all 500 MATH-500 problems, 30 seeded samples per problem, Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and NVIDIA's Nemotron Nano 9B v2 and Nemotron Super 49B v1.5 (a NAS derivative of the same 70B) under vendor sampling, a 65,536-token cap, a pinned Math-Verify scorer, and an append-only attempt ledger, for 45,000 scored responses. The two reasoning models both reach 96.1% accuracy against 76.2% for the 70B baseline. The empirical product-coupling premium is 0.215-0.588 pp across all two- and three-model pools; the empirical plug-in selection headroom over always calling Nano is 1.27 pp; and resampling Nano three times gives practically the same empirical any-correct rate as calling all three models once. Only 31 responses reached the cap, 25 of them with exactly periodic tails, yet the capped responses account for up to 60.2% of a model's output-length-squared proxy, and long generations made a fourth planned model, Llama-3.1-8B, too slow to finish. The premium is far below the companion's 3.5 pp, but models, pool size and protocol changed together; an oracle gap should therefore be reported with the pool, the protocol, the samples per cell and the decoding budget that produced it.
articles.comment: Technical report. 10 pages, 7 figures, 14 tables. Companion to arXiv:2607.03436. Data and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23724735
articles.titleCn: 当强推理者加入池中：LLM路由中的小联盟费用和昂贵的逃跑世代
articles.abstractCn: 路由基准测试通常将路由器与一个后见之明的预言机进行对比，该预言机在任何一个模型的记录答案正确时即认为查询已解决，但在随机解码情况下，该预言机混合了两种不同的对象：对每个查询承诺一个模型的先知上限，以及调用多个模型并保留任何正确答案的溢价。一项配套研究测量了在MATH-500上对11个小型公开模型而言，这种溢价为3.5个百分点（pp）；而当前推理模型进入池中后，其溢价有多大尚不清楚。我们通过在单个NVIDIA B300上进行固定协议、预先承诺的生成来测量它：所有500个MATH-500问题，每个问题30个种子样本，Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct和NVIDIA的Nemotron Nano 9B v2及Nemotron Super 49B v1.5（同70B的NAS衍生模型）在供应商采样下，65,536个token的上限，固定的Math-Verify评分器，以及仅追加的尝试记录账本，共45,000个评分响应。两个推理模型均达到96.1%的准确率，而70B基线的准确率为76.2%。在所有两模型和三模型池中的经验产品耦合溢价为0.215-0.588 pp；经验可插拔选择头室超过始终调用Nano为1.27 pp；重新采样Nano三次在实践中与调用所有三个模型一次的任何正确率几乎相同。只有31个响应达到上限，其中25个具有完全周期性的尾部，但上限响应占模型输出长度平方代理高达60.2%，长生成导致第四个计划模型Llama-3.1-8B太慢无法完成。溢价远低于配套研究的3.5 pp，但模型、池大小和协议是共同变化的；因此，预言机差距应报告与产生它的池、协议、每个单元的样本数和解码预算一起。

articles.title: Same Rule, Different Verdicts: Rubric Language and Clause Structure in LLM Judges for Korean Support Dialogues
articles.abstract: Services that operate in Korean often write their evaluation rubrics in Korean and hand them to an LLM judge. We test whether a judge's verdict depends on the language of the rubric and on how a rubric item is phrased. We write 12 criteria for support dialogues in four clause structures (affirmative, negated, conditional, exception) such that two pairs of structures have the same meaning, and we give each item in Korean and in English. Six low-cost models from three providers, plus one reference model, judge 60 translated ESConv dialogues and 144 constructed boundary cases under every combination (51,744 requests across the seven models). The analysis plan was fixed and committed before data collection. Cross-provider agreement is lower with Korean rubrics than with English rubrics (Cohen's kappa 0.687 vs. 0.745; difference -0.058, 95% CI [-0.072,-0.045]). Disagreement concentrates in negated, conditional, and exception items (odds ratio 5.6 relative to affirmative items). A single model changes its verdict between two items with the same meaning in 11-15% of cases. Two hypotheses are not supported: models from the same provider do not agree more than models from different providers, and adding paired examples does not reduce the language gap. We measure consistency only; no human labels are used, and all materials were drafted by an LLM.
articles.comment: 16 pages, 2 figures. Data and code are included as ancillary files
articles.titleCn: 相同规则，不同裁决：用于韩语支持对话的LLM裁判中的评分标准语言和条款结构
articles.abstractCn: 在韩语环境中运营的服务通常会使用韩语编写评估标准，并将其交给大型语言模型（LLM）裁判。我们测试裁判的裁决是否取决于评估标准的语言以及评估项目措辞方式。我们针对支持对话编写了12项标准，分为四种子句结构（肯定句、否定句、条件句、例外句），其中两对子句结构具有相同含义，并将每个项目用韩语和英语表述。来自三家供应商的六个低成本模型加上一个参考模型，在所有组合下（七种模型共51,744次请求）对60个翻译的ESConv对话和144个构建的边界案例进行裁决。分析计划在数据收集前已固定并承诺。跨供应商的一致性在韩语标准下低于英语标准（Cohen's kappa为0.687对比0.745；差异为-0.058，95%置信区间为[-0.072,-0.045]）。分歧主要集中在否定句、条件句和例外句项目（相对于肯定句项目的优势比为5.6）。在11-15%的情况下，单个模型在具有相同含义的两个项目之间会改变裁决。两个假设未被证实：来自同一供应商的模型并不比来自不同供应商的模型更一致，添加配对示例并不能缩小语言差距。我们仅测量一致性；未使用人工标签，所有材料均由LLM编写。

articles.title: Swapping the Judge Changes the Ranking: A Preregistered Study of Cross-Provider Replication in LLM-Judged System Comparisons
articles.abstract: Practitioners who compare systems with an LLM judge and have no human labels often check a conclusion by repeating it with a judge from another provider. We test how far that check can be trusted. In a preregistered study (with a disclosed post-registration reduction of the judge set), five judge models from three providers re-judged 4,000 Chatbot Arena battles (nine systems, 33 system pairs) that carry human votes, each in both response orders. Agreement with the human vote was low at the verdict level (median Cohen's kappa = 0.22), and system rankings did not survive a change of judge: Kendall's tau with the human ranking ranged from 0.17 to 0.89 (median 0.67), so the preregistered hypothesis that rankings remain stable was not supported. Conclusions replicated by two low-cost judges from different providers matched the human conclusion more often than single-judge conclusions (+0.10 precision), but the gain came from filtering out one poorly aligned judge, and replication involving that judge left a conclusion for only 35% of comparisons. Judges that agreed with humans reached a stable conclusion with no more verdicts than human votes required; the others failed to converge on 26-70% of system pairs at the sample sizes tested (up to 100 verdicts per pair). Disagreements with the human vote co-occurred across judges far more often than independence predicts, although a single human vote per battle cannot separate shared judge bias from voter noise.
articles.comment: 10 pages, 2 figures. Code and judge verdicts are provided as ancillary files
articles.titleCn: 交换评审者会改变排名：一项关于跨提供者复制在LLM评审系统比较中的预先注册研究
articles.abstractCn: 在没有人类标签的情况下，使用大型语言模型（LLM）进行比较系统的实践者通常会通过使用来自另一家供应商的裁判重复结论来进行检查。我们测试了这种检查的可信程度。在一项预先注册的研究（注册后公开减少裁判集）中，来自三家供应商的五个裁判模型重新裁判了4,000场Chatbot Arena对决（九个系统，33个系统对），每个对决在两种响应顺序下进行。在裁决层面，与人类投票的一致性较低（中位数Cohen's kappa为0.22），系统排名在裁判更换时并未保持稳定：与人类排名的Kendall's tau范围在0.17至0.89之间（中位数为0.67），因此预先注册的假设——排名保持稳定——并未得到支持。由两家不同供应商的低成本裁判复制的结论比单一裁判的结论更常与人类结论一致（精确度提升+0.10），但这种收益来自于过滤掉一个表现不佳的裁判，而涉及该裁判的复制仅对35%的对决有效。与人类意见一致的裁判在不需要比人类投票更多的裁决的情况下就能得出稳定结论；而其他裁判在测试的样本量下（每对系统最多100个裁决）在26-70%的系统对上未能达成一致。裁判与人类投票意见不一致的情况比独立性预测的更为频繁，尽管每场对决只有一个人类投票无法区分共享裁判偏差和投票噪声。
